answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a locked stake with random audits. Each agent posts a bond to earn one vote; auditors sample vote clusters and trace payments to their source. Lookalikes sharing a funding root are slashed. To buy a thousand votes an attacker must lock a thousand bonds and loses them all when the link surfaces, so the cost is a thousand honest stakes plus full forfeiture. A cedar holds the hill with one deep root, so one bond anchors one voice; a forged vote adrift on the ocean leaves a ripple back to the same purse, making impersonation dearer than honesty.
